content.short: Nubank is one of the world's largest digital banks, with accounts, cards, loans and crypto across LatAm.
content.description: Nubank, founded in 2013, is one of the world's largest digital banks, serving more than 130 million customers across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. Its app offers no-fee accounts, credit and debit cards, personal loans, savings tools called Caixinhas, insurance, investments and business accounts through Nu Empresas, all in a design-led mobile experience that brought millions of people into the formal financial system. Nubank has also expanded into digital assets, letting users buy, hold and sell crypto such as Bitcoin and stablecoins and launching its Nucoin loyalty token. By pairing mainstream banking at massive scale with growing crypto features, it sits between traditional Latin American finance and Web3.
